source_excerpt: PostgreSQL runtime connections use a five-second connection timeout by default. Set `connect_timeout` in the database URL (for example, `?connect_timeout=10`) or use `PGCONNECT_TIMEOUT` to override it; direct `PostgresRunner` callers may also pass the constructor option.
